name: story-progress
title: Story progress
description: Segmented progress bars for stories and slideshows: tap the thirds to move, hold to pause, nothing advances under reduced motion.
docs: It wraps the media area: pass count, the slide you are on as index with onIndexChange (or defaultIndex), and put the current slide in children, leaving about 3rem free at the top for the segments and the buttons. duration is a number of ms or one per slide; onComplete is called when the last slide's time is up and when someone goes forward from it; going back from the first slide restarts it. A press on the left third goes back and on the right third goes on; holding anywhere pauses while it is down. Links, buttons and fields inside the slide keep working. Keyboard users get Left and Right on the story, a Pause button, and Previous and Next buttons that appear on focus; "Slide 2 of 5" is said once in a polite live region. paused and onPausedChange control the Pause button, autoplay={false} stops the timer so the current segment is simply full, and a hidden tab pauses by itself. The fill is a CSS animation, so pausing keeps the exact place, and under reduced motion nothing advances on its own and the Pause button is not drawn. tone="media" draws white segments for a photo or a dark slide; actions adds buttons beside Pause.
